metadata.database: A Deeper China | Shenzhen decision layer

SZM01.guest_need: A visitor needs to define whether Shenzhen means hardware, consumer tech, manufacturing, AI/EVs, city systems or start-up culture.
SZM01.hidden_need: Prevent a fictional factory-tour expectation before route selection.
SZM01.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A clear technology question is more valuable than a list of famous companies or campuses.
SZM01.stop_condition: The visitor has one technology question and a public evidence path.
SZM01.low_energy_branch: Choose one public interface and stop before adding a second district.
SZM01.rain_branch: Use confirmed indoor exhibitions, markets or showrooms.
SZM01.body_cost: Low-to-moderate walking with high interpretation and access uncertainty.

SZM02.guest_need: A visitor wants to observe Huaqiangbei without being misled about price, quality or sourcing access.
SZM02.hidden_need: Separate public market learning from supplier relationships and private access.
SZM02.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One bounded market observation explains supply-chain language better than bargain hunting across malls.
SZM02.stop_condition: The visitor can distinguish observation, personal purchase and sourcing.
SZM02.low_energy_branch: Use one public market building/edge and leave before overload.
SZM02.rain_branch: Covered market branch after current access check.
SZM02.body_cost: Low-to-moderate walking with crowd, language, payment and IP sensitivity.

SZM03.guest_need: A visitor wants technology as part of ordinary public life rather than a corporate visit.
SZM03.hidden_need: Use transport, delivery, payment and public interfaces as evidence.
SZM03.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: Public interfaces make technology legible without claiming company access.
SZM03.stop_condition: The visitor can identify one technology-in-use pattern and its human friction.
SZM03.rain_branch: Strong indoor branch after programme and entry check.
SZM03.body_cost: Low-to-moderate walking, lower weather exposure but high attention load.

SZM04.guest_need: A visitor wants design, creative reuse and making to balance the hardware story.
SZM04.hidden_need: Match current programme and avoid invented workshop access.
SZM04.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One design/making question adds human production rather than another technology showroom.
SZM04.stop_condition: One current design or making practice is understood.
SZM04.low_energy_branch: Choose one confirmed exhibition or public-facing programme.
SZM04.rain_branch: Indoor branch after programme, opening and ticket checks.
SZM04.body_cost: Low-to-moderate walking with programme and language uncertainty.

SZM05.guest_need: A visitor wants to understand Shenzhen’s innovation-city landscape without a campus tour.
SZM05.hidden_need: Connect skyline, public realm and work geography while keeping access public.
SZM05.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One public Nanshan sequence explains growth and city systems better than chasing company logos.
SZM05.stop_condition: The visitor can describe one relationship between public realm, talent, transport and innovation.
SZM05.rain_branch: Use a confirmed indoor public or exhibition layer.
SZM05.body_cost: Moderate walking and transfer exposure; heat and distance matter.

SZM06.guest_need: A visitor wants historical or lived texture inside a future-city trip.
SZM06.hidden_need: Prevent old-city observation from becoming a staged authenticity claim.
SZM06.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One public street/port comparison shows layers that a tech district alone cannot.
SZM06.stop_condition: One historical or public-life layer is legible without private access.
SZM06.low_energy_branch: Use one bounded public street or port edge.
SZM06.rain_branch: Keep only covered/public layers with current access.
SZM06.body_cost: Moderate walking with heat, crowds and privacy sensitivity.

SZM07.guest_need: A visitor needs Shenzhen positioned as destination, connector or departure city.
SZM07.hidden_need: Make border, airport and intercity timing explicit before adding extensions.
SZM07.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A handoff decision prevents a border or airport day from being disguised as sightseeing.
SZM07.stop_condition: The visitor has current official travel eligibility and a realistic sequence.
SZM07.low_energy_branch: Keep Shenzhen and remove the extension.
SZM07.rain_branch: Use current transport and indoor programme conditions before changing cities.
SZM07.body_cost: Transfer, border and timing sensitivity are high.

SZM08.guest_need: A visitor needs ethical and operational boundaries for a technology trip.
SZM08.hidden_need: Redirect private-access, factory and sourcing requests into public evidence.
SZM08.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A boundary protocol protects the guest and prevents corporate-tourism theatre.
SZM08.stop_condition: The visitor accepts public observation, no private access and no sourcing promise.
SZM08.body_cost: Low physical cost but high privacy, IP and expectation-management load.
